author: GamingBolt
description:
The Midnight Walkers is a new take on the PvPvE extraction shooter genre made popular by titles like Escape From Tarkov, and most recently, ARC Raiders. The game provides its own spin on the genre by swapping out human-like NPC enemies with the walking dead, constantly shambling towards you as you try to get your hands on important goods that you can either sell off for better gear or use to craft better gear. 

Like any Early Access multiplayer shooter, however, The Midnight Walkers has its fair share of issues. It is visually unimpressive, and has also seemingly garnered a highly competitive player base that isn’t really interested in the “live and let live” style of play. Rather, you’re encouraged to either outright avoid other players in the wild, or make sure that you’re ready to fight them off, since there will be no other option.
title: Could This Be The Zombie Extraction Shooter Shooter That Finally Gets It Right?

author: GamingBolt
description:
If Resident Evil Requiem delivers on its promise, it won’t just be one of 2026’s biggest games because of its timing. It’ll be big because it understands how to deliver fear to modern audiences, and crucially how to do it with restraint. 

Sure, it’s confident enough to come out swinging with Leon’s more bombastic setpieces, but through new protagonist Grace it’s bringing back the scares of what’s unseen better than almost anyone else in the genre. In 2026, that’s a rare position for a blockbuster to occupy.
title: Why Resident Evil Requiem May Be the Biggest Game of the Year

author: GamingBolt
description:
The PlayStation 3 generation was a major turning point for Sony, marking an era where technical showcases truly began to define what was possible in gaming. It was a time of great innovation when studios took bigger creative risks and entire genres evolved in meaningful ways. 

From emotionally driven adventures and sprawling open worlds to tight shooters and innovative racers, the PS3 amassed a library that still holds up remarkably well today. To that end, we are counting down 20 of the best PS3 games of all time.
title: 20 MOST ADDICTIVE PS3 Games of All Time You Need To Play [2026 Edition]
